title: Module descent on a connected finite torsor with natural geometric stalk comparisons
statement: Let $V$ be a nonempty connected scheme [def-weil-connected-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\ell$ a prime, $P$ any finite group in its universe, and $c:Y\to V$ a connected finite etale $\operatorname{ULift}(P)$-torsor [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Let $F$ be a sheaf of $\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbf F_\ell)$-modules on $V_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], $A$ a finite-dimensional coefficient module, and suppose $c^*F$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] is isomorphic to the constant sheaf with value $A$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. There exist a finite-dimensional $\mathbf F_\ell$-representation $M$ of $P$ and an additive functor $T$ from all $\mathbf F_\ell$-representations of $P$ to module sheaves on $V$, such that $T(M)\simeq F$, and $T$ takes the trivial representation on $\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbf F_\ell)$ to the constant coefficient sheaf. For every point $x$ of $V$, its canonical universe-lifted geometric stalk functor [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] composed with $T$ and with restriction of scalars along $\mathbf F_\ell\simeq\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbf F_\ell)$ is naturally isomorphic to the underlying-module functor. The representation $M$ is recovered from the given trivialization and the descent datum of $F$; it is not universally quantified. No Sylow subgroup or prime-to-$\ell$ cover is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the additive connected-torsor descent equivalence to obtain E and its underlying associated-sheaf functor T, the natural constant pullback comparison and the trivial coefficient comparison. Regard the given F as an object of the full subcategory using A and hF. Set M=E.inverse(F). Applying the inclusion to the counit gives T(M) isomorphic to F.

Choose a point y on the nonempty connected total space c.P. Compose the inverse of the pullback comparison at M, the pullback of the counit, and hF to identify the two constant sheaves upstairs. Apply the geometric fibre at y and Point.sheafFiberConstantSheafIso to obtain S(M) isomorphic to A. The inverse isomorphism is a surjective semilinear map from A to M.V along ULift.ringEquiv. Module.Finite.of_surjective transports the assumed finite-dimensionality to M.V.

For x in V, use c.surjective.surj to choose z above x and Scheme.exists_fac_of_etale_of_isSepClosed to lift V.algClosurePoint x through c.π. Let Ψ be the universe-lifted point of that lift. upperStarCompUliftSheafFiberIso identifies (c.π)^* followed by Ψ.sheafFiber with the stipulated V.uliftPointSmallEtale x fibre. Whisker the natural pullback comparison with Ψ.sheafFiber and use Point.constantSheafCompSheafFiberIso; this gives T followed by the geometric fibre naturally isomorphic to the underlying-module functor followed by S. Finally whisker with R, restriction along the inverse ring equivalence. The inverse unit of ModuleCat.restrictScalarsEquivalenceOfRingEquiv cancels S followed by R. Functor associators and right unitors supply the specified parentheses. Return this stalk comparison with M, its finite-dimensionality, T and its additivity, the counit comparison and the trivial coefficient comparison.

theorem Scheme.GaloisCover.exists_module_descent_stalk_functor
    {V : Scheme.{u}} [ConnectedSpace V] (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (P : Type u) [Group P] [Finite P]
    (c : Scheme.GaloisCover (ULift.{u + 1} P) V) [ConnectedSpace c.P]
    (F : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))))
    (A : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)))
    [FiniteDimensional (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)) A]
    (hF : Nonempty ((c.π)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))].obj F ≅
      (constantSheaf c.P.smallEtaleTopology
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)))).obj A)) :
    ∃ (M : Rep.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ) P) (_ : FiniteDimensional (ZMod ℓ) M.V)
      (T : Rep.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ) P ⥤
        Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))))
      (_ : T.Additive),
      (∀ x : V, Nonempty
        (T ⋙ (V.uliftPointSmallEtale x).sheafFiber
              (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))) ⋙
            ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1}
              (ULift.ringEquiv.symm.toRingHom : ZMod ℓ →+* ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)) ≅
          forget₂ (Rep.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ) P) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)))) ∧
      Nonempty (T.obj M ≅ F) ∧
      Nonempty (T.obj (Rep.trivial (ZMod ℓ) P (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))) ≅
        (constantSheaf V.smallEtaleTopology
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)))).obj
          (ModuleCat.of _ (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))))
